title: Ecosystem growth fund — first tranche
author: 0x4c8D91Ff20Ae7B3364a1234567890AbCdEf5C77
body: The Collective establishes an ecosystem growth fund and disburses a first tranche of 250,000 USDC to the Growth Working Group multisig for grants to integrators over the following two quarters. Unspent funds return to the treasury at the end of Q4.
